data.description: Result Validator audit (.lattice/orchestration/validation-report.md) found two PARTIAL criteria. Fix both. (1) SPEC #7: capture/machine.go:CaptureMachine() must load .cairn/settings.json and populate machine.hostname_raw when raw_machine_identity=true; currently always hashed. Wire redact/hostname.go:GetHostname() into the capture pipeline. (2) SPEC #11: capture/environ.go:CaptureC11() must populate the pane_lineage field on C11Info; currently always nil. Query c11 CLI for pane ancestry. Add tests for both.
data.title: Fix SPEC #7 and #11 gaps from validation report

data.body:
PR #11 open: https://forgejo.stage11.ai/s11/etch/pulls/11

Both validator gaps fixed and live-validated:
- SPEC #7 raw hostname opt-in: CaptureMachine(settings) populates hostname_raw only on raw_machine_identity=true; wired through session_start. Live: hostname_raw=Hyperion.
- SPEC #11 pane_lineage: c11 has no ancestry API; derived from tree 'here' marker over the pane surface stack (env=UUID vs tree=short-ref mismatch handled). Live: […/Etch, ETCH-9, ETCH-12, ETCH-14].

9 new/updated tests, full suite green, gofmt-clean on touched files. lessons-learned.md updated.

provenance.reason: Duplicate of pre-existing PR #9 (merged at 935327e). Result Validator's branch shipped before ETCH-14 was dispatched. Verified: PR #9 covers both SPEC #7 (CaptureMachine accepts settings, populates HostnameRaw when raw_machine_identity=true) and SPEC #11 (pane_lineage from CAIRN_PANE_LINEAGE + current tab title). 98 LOC + tests.
